keyword: buy type 511 or type 511 diesel sprayer

title.en: Order Type 511 or Type 511 Diesel as a Sprayer, Not a Pump
title.zh: 511 或 511 柴油机按喷涂机订，不要按泵订

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Type 511 at 380 V and 7.5 kW, and Type 511 diesel with a diesel engine and 360 kg. Both are 3 m³/h mortar sprayers. Neither is a trailer pump.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 511 印成 380 V、7.5 kW，把 511 柴油机印成柴油机、360 kg。两者都是 3 m³/h 砂浆喷涂机。都不是拖泵。

h1.en: Choose the 511 Page by Power, Then Inquire
h1.zh: 按动力选定 511 的页面再询盘

directAnswer.en: A 511 purchase at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai is a spraying-machine order. The 380 V page prints 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm and 30 m / 15 m. The diesel page prints a diesel engine, the same 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 32/38 mm, ≤6 mm and 30 m / 15 m, plus 360 kg and 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm. Engine kilowatts are not printed on the diesel sheet. If the site has 380 V for 7.5 kW, open the electric 511. If it does not, open the diesel 511. Do not open Diesel 30.
directAnswer.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台）购买 511，是喷涂机订单。380 V 那一页印 7.5 kW、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm、30 m / 15 m。柴油页印柴油机，同样是 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、32/38 mm、≤6 mm、30 m / 15 m，另有 360 kg 和 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm。柴油页不印发动机千瓦。现场能按 7.5 kW 提供 380 V，就打开电动 511。不能，就打开柴油 511。不要打开柴油30。

body.en: The electric 511 direct answer on the site mentions 260 kg for that electric row. The diesel row prints 360 kg. Do not swap the weights. Do not copy a trailer pump’s centimetre aggregate onto ≤6 mm.
body.zh: 站点上电动 511 的直接回答提到该电动行 260 kg。柴油行印 360 kg。不要对调重量。不要把拖泵的厘米骨料抄到 ≤6 mm 上。

body.en: Both pages are quote-only. Send the path, particle size and whether the site has 380 V to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a 511 price.
body.zh: 两页都只询价。把路径、粒径以及现场是否有 380 V 发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械不印 511 的价格。

heading.zh: 旁边的喷涂行先不要打开

body.en: Type 311 is 4 kW and ≤2 mm. The German type is 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h and ≤5 mm. The diesel concrete sprayer is 28/32 HP and 5 m³/h. Those are different orders.
body.zh: 311 是 4 kW、≤2 mm。德式机是 7.5/9 kW、3–5 m³/h、≤5 mm。柴油混凝土喷涂机是 28/32 HP、5 m³/h。那些是别的订单。

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 is a trailer pump at 15 m³/h and 2000 kg.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油30是 15 m³/h、2000 kg 的拖泵。

question.en: Are engine kW printed on the diesel 511?
question.zh: 柴油 511 印了发动机千瓦吗？

answer.en: No. The sheet says engine kW/HP is not printed.
answer.zh: 没有。该页写明不印发动机 kW/HP。
